mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_memory_index_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ai_memory_index_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=#{request} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ai_memory_index_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND user_id=#{user} AND domain=#{domain} AND state='READY' AND expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY item_id,generation DESC LIMIT 10001
SELECT FROM ai_memory_index_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND item_id=#{item} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_index_job SET state=#{state} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND state=#{expected}
UPDATE ai_memory_outbox SET status='SUCCEEDED',revision=revision+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND event_id=#{id} AND event_type='MEMORY_INDEX_REQUESTED' AND status='QUEUED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='ai_memory_index_job'
SELECT FROM ai_memory_index_job WHERE state='DELETE_PENDING' ORDER BY tenant_id,id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM ai_memory_index_job WHERE state='READY' AND expires_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY expires_at,tenant_id,id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_index_job SET state='DELETE_PENDING',delete_epoch=GREATEST(delete_epoch,#{epoch}) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND state IN ('QUEUED','SENDING','READY','UNKNOWN')
UPDATE ai_memory_index_job SET state='DELETED',delete_receipt_ref=#{receipt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND state='DELETE_PENDING' AND delete_epoch=#{epoch}
